decisions: Kept relative Vite base and relative manifest start_url/scope for GitHub Pages portability.
Used prompt mode with injectRegister disabled so src/pwa.ts owns registration and activation requires explicit confirmation.
Added a small unsaved-changes registry in src/pwa.ts for feature forms to gate activation.
Aliased virtual:pwa-register to a test stub in vitest.config.ts so component tests can drive waiting-worker behavior.
Set includeManifestIcons false to avoid duplicate precache entries while glob patterns cache the icons once.
Manifest theme colors are provisional literals; ui-engineer owns final locked tokens in FND-5.
interfaces: registerPwa, setUnsavedChanges, confirmUpdate, dismissUpdate, subscribeToUpdatePrompt, getUpdatePromptState from src/pwa.ts

payload.taskDescription: Configure vite-plugin-pwa in prompt mode with a same-origin manifest, relative start_url and scope, standalone display, any orientation, and 192px, 512px, and maskable 512px PNG icons generated from public/icons/icon.svg by scripts/generate-icons.mjs using sharp. Register the service worker from src/pwa.ts, import it from src/main.tsx, and mount the UpdatePrompt toast from src/App.tsx with Refresh and Later actions. The prompt must call updateServiceWorker(true) only after explicit confirmation. Precache the app shell and allow future wasm and traineddata assets. Do not enable skipWaiting or claim offline verification yet.
